agent_links_external_check.name: agent_links_external_check
agent_links_external_check.value: "agent_links"."status" not in ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED') or "agent_links"."external_agent_id" is not null

agent_provisioning_jobs_outcome_check.name: agent_provisioning_jobs_outcome_check
agent_provisioning_jobs_outcome_check.value: ("agent_provisioning_jobs"."status" = 'SUCCEEDED' and "agent_provisioning_jobs"."completed_at" is not null and "agent_provisioning_jobs"."error_category" is null) or ("agent_provisioning_jobs"."status" = 'FAILED' and "agent_provisioning_jobs"."completed_at" is not null and "agent_provisioning_jobs"."error_category" is not null) or ("agent_provisioning_jobs"."status" in ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'CANCELLED') and "agent_provisioning_jobs"."completed_at" is null and "agent_provisioning_jobs"."error_category" is null)

audit_events_actor_id_check.name: audit_events_actor_id_check
audit_events_actor_id_check.value: ("audit_events"."actor_type" = 'ANONYMOUS' and "audit_events"."actor_id" is null) or ("audit_events"."actor_type" <> 'ANONYMOUS' and "audit_events"."actor_id" is not null)

billing_webhook_events_outcome_check.name: billing_webhook_events_outcome_check
billing_webhook_events_outcome_check.value: ("billing_webhook_events"."status" = 'PROCESSING' and "billing_webhook_events"."processed_at" is null and "billing_webhook_events"."next_attempt_at" is null and "billing_webhook_events"."failure_code" is null) or ("billing_webhook_events"."status" in ('PROCESSED', 'IGNORED') and "billing_webhook_events"."processed_at" is not null and "billing_webhook_events"."next_attempt_at" is null and "billing_webhook_events"."failure_code" is null) or ("billing_webhook_events"."status" = 'FAILED' and "billing_webhook_events"."processed_at" is null and "billing_webhook_events"."failure_code" is not null)

customer_integrations_error_check.name: customer_integrations_error_check
customer_integrations_error_check.value: ("customer_integrations"."status" in ('DEGRADED', 'ERROR') and "customer_integrations"."error_code" is not null) or ("customer_integrations"."status" not in ('DEGRADED', 'ERROR') and "customer_integrations"."error_code" is null)

customer_invitations_acceptance_check.name: customer_invitations_acceptance_check
customer_invitations_acceptance_check.value: ("customer_invitations"."status" = 'ACCEPTED' and "customer_invitations"."accepted_at" is not null) or ("customer_invitations"."status" <> 'ACCEPTED' and "customer_invitations"."accepted_at" is null)

discount_redemptions_claim_check.name: discount_redemptions_claim_check
discount_redemptions_claim_check.value: ("discount_redemptions"."redemption_type" = 'PROMOTION_CLAIM' and "discount_redemptions"."promotion_code_id" is not null and "discount_redemptions"."amount_discounted_minor" = 0) or ("discount_redemptions"."redemption_type" = 'CHARGE_APPLICATION' and "discount_redemptions"."amount_discounted_minor" > 0)

discounts_value_check.name: discounts_value_check
discounts_value_check.value: ("discounts"."discount_type" = 'PERCENTAGE' and "discounts"."percent_off_basis_points" between 1 and 10000 and "discounts"."amount_off_minor" is null and "discounts"."currency" is null) or ("discounts"."discount_type" = 'FIXED_AMOUNT' and "discounts"."percent_off_basis_points" is null and "discounts"."amount_off_minor" > 0 and length("discounts"."currency") = 3 and "discounts"."currency" = upper("discounts"."currency"))

discounts_duration_check.name: discounts_duration_check
discounts_duration_check.value: ("discounts"."duration_type" = 'REPEATING' and "discounts"."duration_months" > 0) or ("discounts"."duration_type" in ('ONCE', 'FOREVER') and "discounts"."duration_months" is null)

idempotency_keys_response_check.name: idempotency_keys_response_check
idempotency_keys_response_check.value: ("idempotency_keys"."state" = 'PROCESSING' and "idempotency_keys"."response_status" is null and "idempotency_keys"."response_body_json" is null) or ("idempotency_keys"."state" = 'COMPLETED' and "idempotency_keys"."response_status" between 200 and 499 and "idempotency_keys"."response_body_json" is not null)

invoices_dates_check.name: invoices_dates_check
invoices_dates_check.value: ("invoices"."due_at" is null or "invoices"."issued_at" is not null) and ("invoices"."due_at" is null or "invoices"."due_at" >= "invoices"."issued_at") and (("invoices"."status" = 'PAID' and "invoices"."paid_at" is not null) or ("invoices"."status" <> 'PAID' and "invoices"."paid_at" is null))

notification_deliveries_outcome_check.name: notification_deliveries_outcome_check
notification_deliveries_outcome_check.value: ("notification_deliveries"."status" = 'SENT' and "notification_deliveries"."sent_at" is not null and "notification_deliveries"."provider_reference" is not null and "notification_deliveries"."error_category" is null) or ("notification_deliveries"."status" = 'FAILED' and "notification_deliveries"."sent_at" is null and "notification_deliveries"."error_category" is not null) or ("notification_deliveries"."status" in ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'CANCELLED') and "notification_deliveries"."sent_at" is null and "notification_deliveries"."error_category" is null)

onboarding_cases_lifecycle_check.name: onboarding_cases_lifecycle_check
onboarding_cases_lifecycle_check.value:
("onboarding_cases"."status" = 'NOT_STARTED' and "onboarding_cases"."started_at" is null and "onboarding_cases"."ready_at" is null and "onboarding_cases"."completed_at" is null and "onboarding_cases"."cancelled_at" is null) or
      ("onboarding_cases"."status" in ('IN_PROGRESS', 'BLOCKED') and "onboarding_cases"."started_at" is not null and "onboarding_cases"."ready_at" is null and "onboarding_cases"."completed_at" is null and "onboarding_cases"."cancelled_at" is null) or
      ("onboarding_cases"."status" = 'READY' and "onboarding_cases"."started_at" is not null and "onboarding_cases"."ready_at" is not null and "onboarding_cases"."completed_at" is null and "onboarding_cases"."cancelled_at" is null) or
      ("onboarding_cases"."status" = 'COMPLETED' and "onboarding_cases"."started_at" is not null and "onboarding_cases"."ready_at" is not null and "onboarding_cases"."completed_at" is not null and "onboarding_cases"."cancelled_at" is null) or
      ("onboarding_cases"."status" = 'CANCELLED' and "onboarding_cases"."completed_at" is null and "onboarding_cases"."cancelled_at" is not null)

onboarding_tasks_completion_check.name: onboarding_tasks_completion_check
onboarding_tasks_completion_check.value: ("onboarding_tasks"."status" = 'DONE' and "onboarding_tasks"."completed_at" is not null) or ("onboarding_tasks"."status" <> 'DONE' and "onboarding_tasks"."completed_at" is null)

onboarding_tasks_blocked_check.name: onboarding_tasks_blocked_check
onboarding_tasks_blocked_check.value: ("onboarding_tasks"."status" = 'BLOCKED' and "onboarding_tasks"."blocked_reason" is not null) or ("onboarding_tasks"."status" <> 'BLOCKED' and "onboarding_tasks"."blocked_reason" is null)

operational_queue_items_claim_check.name: operational_queue_items_claim_check
operational_queue_items_claim_check.value: ("operational_queue_items"."status" = 'CLAIMED' and "operational_queue_items"."assigned_to_admin_user_id" is not null and "operational_queue_items"."claimed_at" is not null and "operational_queue_items"."resolved_at" is null) or ("operational_queue_items"."status" = 'OPEN' and "operational_queue_items"."assigned_to_admin_user_id" is null and "operational_queue_items"."claimed_at" is null and "operational_queue_items"."resolved_at" is null) or ("operational_queue_items"."status" in ('COMPLETED', 'DISMISSED') and "operational_queue_items"."resolved_at" is not null)

payment_reminders_outcome_check.name: payment_reminders_outcome_check
payment_reminders_outcome_check.value: ("payment_reminders"."status" = 'SENT' and "payment_reminders"."sent_at" is not null and "payment_reminders"."failure_code" is null) or ("payment_reminders"."status" = 'FAILED' and "payment_reminders"."sent_at" is null and "payment_reminders"."failure_code" is not null) or ("payment_reminders"."status" in ('SCHEDULED', 'CANCELLED') and "payment_reminders"."sent_at" is null and "payment_reminders"."failure_code" is null)

plan_features_limit_unit_check.name: plan_features_limit_unit_check
plan_features_limit_unit_check.value: ("plan_features"."limit_value" is null and "plan_features"."limit_unit" is null) or ("plan_features"."limit_value" is not null and "plan_features"."limit_unit" is not null)

price_quotes_amounts_check.name: price_quotes_amounts_check
price_quotes_amounts_check.value: "price_quotes"."base_price_minor" >= 0 and ("price_quotes"."override_price_minor" is null or "price_quotes"."override_price_minor" >= 0) and "price_quotes"."discount_total_minor" >= 0 and "price_quotes"."subtotal_minor" >= 0 and "price_quotes"."tax_minor" >= 0 and "price_quotes"."total_minor" = "price_quotes"."subtotal_minor" + "price_quotes"."tax_minor"

service_credentials_revocation_check.name: service_credentials_revocation_check
service_credentials_revocation_check.value: ("service_credentials"."status" = 'ACTIVE' and "service_credentials"."revoked_at" is null and "service_credentials"."revoked_by_admin_user_id" is null) or ("service_credentials"."status" = 'REVOKED' and "service_credentials"."revoked_at" is not null and "service_credentials"."revoked_by_admin_user_id" is not null)

subscription_entitlements_limit_check.name: subscription_entitlements_limit_check
subscription_entitlements_limit_check.value: ("subscription_entitlements"."limit_value" is null and "subscription_entitlements"."limit_unit" is null) or ("subscription_entitlements"."limit_value" >= 0 and "subscription_entitlements"."limit_unit" is not null)

subscriptions_period_check.name: subscriptions_period_check
subscriptions_period_check.value: ("subscriptions"."current_period_start" is null and "subscriptions"."current_period_end" is null) or ("subscriptions"."current_period_start" is not null and "subscriptions"."current_period_end" > "subscriptions"."current_period_start")

subscriptions_cancellation_check.name: subscriptions_cancellation_check
subscriptions_cancellation_check.value: ("subscriptions"."status" = 'CANCELLED' and "subscriptions"."cancelled_at" is not null) or ("subscriptions"."status" <> 'CANCELLED' and "subscriptions"."cancelled_at" is null)

subscriptions_external_check.name: subscriptions_external_check
subscriptions_external_check.value: ("subscriptions"."external_billing_provider" is null and "subscriptions"."external_customer_id" is null and "subscriptions"."external_subscription_id" is null) or ("subscriptions"."external_billing_provider" is not null and "subscriptions"."external_customer_id" is not null)
